_comment: Cells that cannot be measured ON THIS HOST for environmental reasons — no hardware virtualization, a vCPU without the instruction set an image's binaries need, or a kernel feature a task requires. This is NOT the same claim as a broken task: the task may be perfectly solvable on hardware that satisfies it, so these cells are excluded from 'broken' counts and any rate computed from this machine has to say it was measured without them. Never put an agent's failure here: a cell that is merely hard belongs in the reports as a loss.
